title: Back bend
instruction: Hands on your lower back, lean back gently. Hold 20s.

title: Forward fold
instruction: Knees soft, let your upper body hang toward the floor. Hold 30s.

title: Standing twist
instruction: Feet hip-width, arms loose, turn your torso slowly side to side. 10 each way.

title: Hip flexor stretch
instruction: Step one foot back, bend the front knee slightly, tuck the hips. 20s each side.

title: Calf raises
instruction: Rise onto your toes, lower slowly. 15 times.

title: Neck side stretch
instruction: Drop one ear toward your shoulder, relax. 15s each side.

title: Chin tucks
instruction: Stand tall, pull your chin straight back, hold 3s. 8 times.

title: Shoulder rolls
instruction: Roll your shoulders backward slowly. 10 times.

title: Chest opener
instruction: Clasp your hands behind your back, lift slightly, open the chest. Hold 20s.

title: Wrist stretch
instruction: Arm out, palm up, gently pull your fingers back with the other hand. 15s each side.

title: Walk
instruction: Walk to the kitchen and back. Refill your water.
